application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description:
Rear
T1 Silver Birch x 1 (Betula pendula / alba)
This 12m silver birch has not previously been reduced, but the neighbour has cut a branch back to the boundary that has died. The tree has outgrown its location.
Suggested work:
- sensitive full crown reduction
- reduce the height by 2.5m
- reduce the lateral growth by 2-3m
- thin by 15%
- remove climbing rose from the crown break, cut down to fence height

Rear
T2 Cherry x 1 (Prunus spp) 
This 14m cherry tree has not been reduced previously. It is growing close to the property, with lateral branches touching the roof. With a tree this size on London clay base there will always be a risk of
subsidence. We recommend removal and replanting with another fruit tree.
- fell to ground level

Front
T3 Buddleia x 1 
This overgrown buddleia offers good privacy to the front of the house, but needs pruning
to maintain a more desirable shape.
Suggested work:
- reduce back from the house by 2-3m
- reduce the height of the remaining canopy 2m
- cut back from pavement to boundary of garden
